authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES the FC-DEGRADED broken-input images from doctor-contract.v4. It does not author pre-image or post-image bytes. It does not author report bytes. It does not invent last-known revocation bytes. It does not invent a lease, refcount, or lock. It does not execute FC-DEGRADED. It does not close OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-114. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING at FC-DEGRADED without inventing tree images or report goldens. doctor v4 exactByteIntent names seven DEG images and enumerates lock, ladder, and clock sub-images. This catalog records those named images. Every pre/post digest and report remains NOT-AUTHORED.

doctorV4.fcDegradedExactByteIntent: Seven pinned broken-input images, one per DEG-1..DEG-7, each byte-pinned pre and post, each with its doctor report bytes: bit-flipped install entries against a recorded inventory; a truncated lock, a duplicate-key lock, and an absent lock; a lock referencing an uninstalled component; an artifact present in the recorded revocation state; a state tree left at each position of the prepare/commit/abort ladder including the post-crash ambiguous case; a fixture whose host clock is skewed forward and backward across the invocation with recorded revocation and expiry timestamps pinned (DEG-6); and a fixture in which a named state source's identity is mutated by a second process between doctor's first and last measurement of it (DEG-7).

fcRoV1.role: Sibling. Names DEG-1..DEG-7 as FC-RO read-only variants. This catalog names the same DEG identifiers as FC-DEGRADED report-honesty images. It does not merge the two classes and does not author either image set.
